data.name: Ganpat
data.gender_notes: Ganpat is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ganapat is a Sanskrit name meaning 'Lord of Ganas'. In Hindu mythology, Ganesha is the elephant-headed god, who is the lord of beginnings, wisdom, and remover of obstacles. The name Ganpat carries the meaning “Lord of Ganas (groups)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ganpat usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of ganas (groups) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes wisdom, power, and the ability to overcome obstacles.
data.etymology: Ganpat belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Ganas (groups).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ganpat total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
